Landing.heroSubtitle: Track balances, prices, and alerts across 10 networks — all in one place. No private keys needed.
Landing.feedTitle: The crypto market, distilled into one live feed
Landing.feedDescription: Follow news, listings, arbitrage opportunities, price anomalies, liquidations and airdrops collected from selected Telegram channels.
Landing.feedSignalDesc: Price anomalies and major liquidations, grouped for faster scanning.
Landing.feedOpportunityDesc: Listings, arbitrage and airdrops separated from the noise.
Landing.feedNewsDesc: Updates from selected sources in one searchable stream.
Landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three steps to full portfolio visibility
Landing.step1Desc: Paste any public EVM or Solana address. No registration of private keys — read-only access.
Landing.step2Desc: We fetch balances from Ankr, Helius, and Blockscout across 10 networks and automatically filter spam tokens.
Landing.step3Desc: Monitor price changes, set Telegram alerts, and compare wallets with each other.
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to monitor your portfolio
Landing.feature1Desc: Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, X Layer, Robinhood and Solana.
Landing.feature2Desc: Telegram notifications when the price changes by the set % or reaches a target.
Landing.feature3Desc: Charts, allocation by network, PnL dynamics and wallet comparison.
Landing.feature4Desc: Read-only mode. Add any public address without any risk.
Landing.telegramSubtitle: Get instant notifications directly in messenger
Landing.telegramDesc: Set price triggers and receive alerts in Telegram when the market moves. No need to constantly monitor charts.
Landing.faq1q: Is it safe to add a public address?
Landing.faq1a: Absolutely. We only use public blockchain data. No private keys or signatures are required — we cannot make any transactions.
Landing.faq2a: Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, X Layer, Robinhood (all EVM) and Solana. Support for more networks is planned.
Landing.faq3a: Go to Settings, enter your Telegram Chat ID, then create a trigger with your desired threshold. You'll receive a message when the condition is met.
Landing.faq4a: Prices update automatically every 15 minutes via CoinGecko. Wallet balances are updated on manual sync or via the Sync All button.
Landing.marketUnavailable: Price updates are temporarily unavailable. Displayed data may be outdated.

Exchanges.title: Exchanges
Exchanges.subtitle: Read-only accounts, balances and connection health.
Exchanges.keyInstructions: Create a dedicated read-only key. Disable trading, withdrawals and transfers. Restrict it to the worker IP below. The key is encrypted and cannot be displayed again.
Exchanges.supported: Supported: Binance Spot and USDⓈ-M, Bybit Unified, Gate classic Spot and USDT perpetuals, global OKX trading account (spot and linear USDT/USDC perpetuals), BingX Spot and USDT perpetuals, Hyperliquid core perpetuals. Earn, funding wallets, options, inverse and portfolio margin are excluded.
Exchanges.passphraseHint: API passphrase chosen when creating the OKX key, not your account password. Global OKX accounts only.
Exchanges.gatePermissionsHint: Gate: classic account, Spot, Futures, Account and Unified permissions — read-only, with the worker IP allowlisted. Key permissions must be available via the main-account API.
Exchanges.bingxPermissionsHint: BingX: enable Read only and allowlist the worker IP. Leave trading, withdrawals and transfers disabled. Supports Spot and USDT perpetual futures.
Exchanges.reauthHint: Required if you signed in over 10 minutes ago. Social-login users can sign in again.
Exchanges.emptyDescription: Connect a read-only account to see its assets and open positions alongside your wallets.
Exchanges.waitingForWorker: Waiting for the first successful sync.
Exchanges.hyperAuto: Hyperliquid is detected from existing wallet balances automatically.
Exchanges.positionsSubtitle: Open positions across exchanges. Updated approximately every 30 seconds.
Exchanges.asterWalletInstructions: Aster positions and futures collateral are read by wallet address. Spot, paid funding, realized PnL, fees and liquidation prices require API access and are not available in this mode. Disable account privacy in Aster to make positions visible.
Exchanges.noPositions: No open positions match these filters. Check connection status if data has not synced yet.
Exchanges.realizedPnlDescription: Closing PnL plus funding minus trading fees since position opening.
Exchanges.fundingUnavailable: Payment history could not be attributed to this position.
Exchanges.assetEquityNote: Asset holdings are a breakdown of accounts, not an amount to add to equity. Equity can include liabilities and unrealized PnL.
Exchanges.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this source and delete its stored API key? Historical snapshots will remain. Revoke the key on the exchange separately.
Exchanges.queued: Refresh queued. The worker will update saved data shortly.
Exchanges.partialCapital: Partial valuation: some accounts or asset prices are missing.
Exchanges.staleCapital: Some sources are stale. The last known values are retained.
Exchanges.historyEmpty: History starts with the first snapshot. The worker records one every five minutes.
Exchanges.historyNote: Change in value includes deposits, withdrawals and connected accounts. It is not investment profit.

errors.UNAVAILABLE: The exchange is temporarily unavailable. Previous data is retained; the worker will retry.
errors.INVALID_KEY: The API key is invalid or expired. Replace it with a read-only key.
errors.UNSAFE_KEY: Key rejected: trading, withdrawal or transfer permissions must be disabled.
errors.IP_RESTRICTED: Check that the key is restricted to the worker IP and has read access.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: Too many requests. Wait before refreshing again.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The exchange returned incomplete or unexpected data. Previous data is retained.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_ACCOUNT: This account mode or its open products are not supported. Previous values may be stale.
errors.FUTURES_UNAVAILABLE: Futures cannot be read with this key. Spot data is retained. Do not enable trading to bypass this restriction.
errors.SPOT_UNAVAILABLE: Aster spot is not included: reading it requires API access. Futures positions remain available.
errors.PRIVATE_ACCOUNT: Aster account privacy hides balances and positions. Disable it in Aster to sync by wallet address. Previous data is retained.
errors.UNPRICED_ASSETS: Some assets have no trusted USD valuation. The total is incomplete.
errors.DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT: This key or exchange account is already connected.
errors.CONFIGURATION: Exchange monitoring is not configured correctly. Contact the operator.
errors.WORKER_OFFLINE: The exchange worker is offline or has not started. Saved data may be stale.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Confirm your current password or sign in again before replacing the API key.
errors.CONNECTION_INACTIVE: Resume the connection or replace its key before refreshing.
errors.REFRESH_PARTIAL: Some refresh requests were not accepted. Check connection status and try again later.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Connection not found or feature unavailable.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The request could not be completed. Try again later.

Exchanges.legacyNote: Saved snapshots of the previous wallet-only portfolio. Exchange balances are not reconstructed for past dates.
Exchanges.migrationPending: Migration pending; not added to total
Exchanges.positionsIncomplete: Some accounts have not synced completely. The list may be incomplete or stale.
Exchanges.hideValuationWarnings: Hide unpriced assets and valuation warnings
Exchanges.closedAfterFeesDescription: Position closes minus trading fees. Funding is shown separately.
Exchanges.feesUnavailable: Fees are unavailable or require currency conversion.
Exchanges.liquidationDistanceDescription: Mark price change to the current liquidation price.
Exchanges.breakEvenDescription: For the remaining size: closes + funding − fees already incurred. Future closing fees and funding are excluded.
Exchanges.nextFundingDescription: Current exchange estimate; rate may change before settlement. Positive rate: longs pay shorts.
